title: Gravel Racing: Family Events – Two Kids, a Wife, and a Bike in a Van – Miguel Ovalles
content:
Miguel from The Radavist’s Race Metal series has been racing gravel for the last two years. This time, he’s trying to figure out if he can bring his whole family along for race weekends without breaking the bank. For Gravel Worlds 300, Miguel, his wife Susan, and their two kids travel to Nebraska in a Wayfarer van and camp right at the venue.

But bringing the family comes with a question: can he still properly prepare, get enough rest, and race 300 miles when being a dad doesn’t exactly come with a guaranteed good night’s sleep?

At the same time, having his family there gives Miguel something he doesn’t get when racing alone. Knowing they’re waiting for him at the finish line might be the extra motivation he needs to keep pushing and get back to them faster. So, can he race 300 miles and still be a present dad and husband in between? Follow along as Miguel balances family life, race preparation, and 300 miles of Nebraska gravel at Gravel Worlds.

Thanks to Wayfarer for setting Miguel up with a van for the 2026 Gravel Worlds! Check out the Wayfarer van conversion they used here.
